posts.text: Ledger 3.0 is out today. Three things changed: imports are 5x faster, budgets sync across devices, and every report exports to CSV. A thread on what we measured #cafe #2026
Imports first. A 40,000-row bank file now loads in 1.2 s instead of 6.1 s, and the preview shows the first 50 rows before you commit.
posts.note: Numbers from the release notes, section 2

media.alt: Import preview showing the first 50 rows of a bank file

posts.text: Budgets now sync through your own storage, not ours. Full method and raw timings: benchmarks https://example.com/ledger-3-benchmarks

Literal text stays literal

Template tokens like {{x}} stay as typed, and so do amounts like $1, $& and $'. Field names such as opening_balance and snake_case keys survive unchanged, and *stars* stay.
CSV export covers every report, with one schema and stable column names.
Upgrade from the app menu. Thanks to the 64 people who tested the betas. 🙏
